items.title: Wynn Holds UAE Casino Date but Weighs How to Open Amid War
items.snippet: Skift Take: Wynn is holding to its September 2027 date for the UAE’s first casino resort but it will now decide in February what form the opening takes. The U.S.-Iran war means its first customers may travel from down the road in Dubai and elsewhere in the UAE, rather than being the international guests it primarily wants.

items.title: Embergrove Hospitality Group to Manage Historic Hotel Pattee in Perry, Iowa
items.snippet: Embergrove Hospitality Group, which also manages Frank Lloyd Wright's Historic Park Inn, takes over Hotel Pattee on December 1 in a partnership with the City of Perry.

items.title: Nasi and Mee targets 50 outlets, plans INR 50-crore capex
items.snippet: Foodsta Kitchens plans to expand its Nasi and Mee brand from 15 to 50 outlets over the next three years, strengthening its presence across key markets with a capital expenditure outlay of around INR 50 crore. The company expects the expansion to drive a threefold increase in revenue, with growth initially concentrated in South India before it moves into western and northern markets.

items.title: Espire Hospitality targets 40% revenue contribution from weddings in 3 years
items.snippet: Espire Hospitality is targeting a significant increase in wedding-led business, aiming to take the segment’s contribution to 40% and beyond of its overall revenue over the next three years.

items.title: Korea Tourism Organization, New Delhi Office Hosts Successful Roadshow 2026 in Ahmedabad and Mumbai
items.snippet: The Korea Tourism Organization (KTO) New Delhi Office successfully hosted the Korea Tourism Roadshow 2026 in Ahmedabad on 28th October and Mumbai on 4th November, bringing together key stakeholders from India’s travel trade and tourism industry to explore new business opportunities and strengthen tourism ties between India and South Korea.

items.title: Lemon Tree Hotels reports 18 percent revenue growth, 90 percent PAT surge in Q2 FY27
items.snippet: Lemon Tree Hotels delivered a strong performance in Q2 FY27, with total revenue rising 18 percent year on year to Rs 363.8 crore and PAT jumping 90 percent to Rs 79.8 crore. Net EBITDA grew 22 percent to Rs 162.2 crore, while the net EBITDA margin improved to 44.6 percent. The company expanded its network with eight hotel openings and 11 new signings, while reducing gross debt by 11 percent year on year.

items.title: Juniper Hotels Limited reports strong performance in Q2 and H1FY27
items.snippet: Q2 FY27 total income grew 10 percent YoY to Rs 258.1 crore, with ARR up 9 percent and RevPAR rising 12 percent. EBITDA for that period stood at Rs 91.4 crore, while PAT surged 121 percent YoY to Rs 37.2 crore while H1 FY27 total income reached Rs 510.3 crore (+10 percent), EBITDA Rs 180.3 crore and PAT Rs 70.4 crore (+173 percent), said a release.

items.title: Eve & FlyBIS sign agreement for 12 eVTOLs
items.snippet: Eve Air Mobility and Brazilian operator FlyBIS have signed a binding agreement for up to 12 electric Vertical Take-Off and Landing (eVTOL) aircraft, marking a step towards establishing electric air mobility operations in Southern Brazil. The agreement includes two firm orders and purchase rights for ten additional aircraft, building on a Letter of Intent signed by the companies in 2022.
